integrity: The proof derives the complete adjoint-rank strata directly from the two bracket presentations and uses rank-nullity only after the strata are established. The packaged replay reconstructs both brackets, checks Jacobi, computes every adjoint matrix and rank in three finite-field cases including GF(4), and independently enumerates commuting pairs in a small case.
scientific_limitations: Only the two explicitly presented maximal-class filiform families are covered; arbitrary filiform deformations are not classified.
The originality domain is dimension at least six; the five-dimensional standard-model boundary was already computed in the motivating literature.
The theorem concerns finite fields and does not classify commuting varieties over infinite fields.
The asymptotic limits are consequences of exact formulas; existence of families with those limiting values is not claimed as new.
title: Adjoint-rank spectra of two maximal-class filiform Lie algebras
